name: @w6w-apps/ebay
description: Search and read live eBay listings through the Buy Browse API.

w6w.longDescription:
eBay covers the Buy Browse API — the public-listing surface of eBay's REST platform, which lives on api.ebay.com alongside every other eBay REST API (Sell, Buy, Commerce). A keyword or category search returns a page of item summaries with price, condition, seller and shipping data; a single item (by its RESTful item ID, its legacy numeric ID, or as one variation in a multi-variation listing group) can be read in full.

Authentication is app-level rather than tied to any individual buyer or seller: eBay's client-credentials grant mints an Application access token from a registered app's Client ID and Secret, so this app works in scheduled and unattended runs with no browser sign-in step. That token authorizes only eBay's public-data scope — it cannot see or touch any seller's own inventory, orders or account, which is a different, user-consented part of eBay's API surface this app does not cover.

A quota check reads eBay's own Analytics API for real call-count headroom against the Browse API's rate limit, using the same application token.
